prayerExcerpt.en-US: O God, Father of mercies, who sent Saint Jerome Emiliani as a helper and father to orphans.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Ó Deus, Pai das misericórdias, que, em São Jerônimo Emiliani destes aos órfãos um protetor e pai.

meta.face: A Venetian man of about fifty, worn thin by famine and plague, with a LONG OVAL face — a high, domed forehead going bald, dark-brown hair thinning over the crown and falling a little unkempt at the sides behind the ears; a long, straight, rather prominent nose; large, dark, luminous eyes lifted upward under dark brows that slope down at the outer ends, giving a look of compassion; lean cheeks; a full, soft, dark-brown beard of medium length, rounded at the chin and threaded with grey, and a full moustache; the lips a little parted as in prayer.
meta.basis: Giandomenico Tiepolo's painting (the Wikipedia lead) shows him balding, with a full dark beard and eyes raised, holding a chain with an orphan at his side; he died of the plague at Somasca at fifty. The card follows it.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Jerome Emiliani (lead: Giandomenico Tiepolo, Ca' Rezzonico)
